<h2>Run Project Configuration Generation</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates modular configuration sources and materialises tracked artifacts.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_configuration_generation(
  path_manifest = here::here("Configuration/manifest.yml"),
  path_source_root = here::here(),
  path_destination_root = path_source_root
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="path_manifest">path_manifest</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the configuration ordering manifest.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_source_root">path_source_root</code></td>
<td>
<p>Repository root used to resolve manifest fragment and reference paths.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_destination_root">path_destination_root</code></td>
<td>
<p>Root under which generated artifact paths are written.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The function validates the complete source set and semantic reference in a
temporary directory before writing either destination artifact.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Data frame describing validated profiles and their generated catalog fields.
</p>

</main>
